name: Moshimo Yakyuubu no Joshi Manager ga Otoko no Ko Dattara...
original_name: もしも野球部の女子マネージャーが男の娘だったら…
source:
"If only we had pretty female manager for our baseball team, surely we would win! That's impossible, however, because we're in an all boys school!"
Looking at his team, Masaru is filled with determination, but he won't help the way he imagined he would...
